name: dbhq
description: Free, open-source Claude Code and Codex tools by DBHQ

plugins.name: outlook-graph
plugins.description: Microsoft 365 mail and calendar, run from your agent - read, search, send, manage drafts and attachments, and check availability. Also turns a PST archive into searchable markdown with a SHA256 chain of custody over every message.

plugins.name: trello
plugins.description: Trello end to end from your agent - boards, lists and cards, plus an instant board digest, a due-date radar for what is slipping, and smart card sorting. Four skills in one install.

plugins.name: legwork
plugins.description: Research that settles a decision, and says when it cannot. A source is judged by the claim it backs, sources only corroborate when they could have disagreed, and every finding states how well it is supported.

plugins.name: dovetail
plugins.description: Checks whether a repository still agrees with itself - dead links, moved anchors, orphaned files, documentation describing behaviour the code no longer has. The exact checks need no model and no network, so they are safe to gate a build on.

plugins.name: verve
plugins.description: Strips AI tells from prose and puts a human voice back, in British English. Meaning is a veto: every figure, name and claim survives. Prose only - no packages, no network, no paid tier.

plugins.name: vela
plugins.description: Compiler-exact code search for .NET - where a symbol is defined, every reference, who calls it, what a change breaks. Roslyn-backed, so Razor views and Blazor components are indexed rather than skipped.
